practicesLabel: Inquiry, Physics Command Terms and HL Extensions
practices: Assessments evaluate core themes across 5 Themes (A to E) plus all HL Extensions. High emphasis on analytical quantitative problems, experimental error evaluation, and higher cognitive command terms. Follow standard IB equations in data booklet format. Calculus is concepts-integrated but calculations are algebra/trig based.

keyTopics: Kinematics: distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration
Forces and momentum: Newton's Laws, collisions, impulse
Work, energy and power: conservation of energy, mechanical power
Rigid body mechanics: torque, rotational inertia, angular momentum (HL Extension)
Galilean and special relativity (HL Extension)

units.unitTitle: The particulate nature of matter (SL + HL)
keyTopics: Thermal energy transfers, specific heat capacity
Greenhouse effect, albedo
Gas laws, ideal gases
Thermodynamics: engine cycles, entropy, first and second laws (HL Extension)
Simple harmonic motion, oscillations
Wave model, Doppler effect (HL Extension)
Wave phenomena: reflection, refraction, polarization
Standing waves and resonance
Diffraction and resolution limits, Rayleigh criterion (HL Extension)
Gravitational fields, gravitational field strength
Electric fields, Coulomb's law, electric potential & equipotentials (HL Extension)
Magnetic fields, force on moving charges
Electromagnetic induction, induced EMF, Faraday's & Lenz's laws
Power generation, transformers, AC circuits & capacitors (HL Extension)
Quantum and nuclear physics: photoelectric effect, wave duality, radioactive decay (HL Extension)

antiPatterns: Ensure students show advanced mechanical and electromagnetic cycle calculations. Out of scope are: memorization of historical discovery names beyond standard booklet names; detailed mathematical derivations using advanced vector calculus; and quantum field theory calculations.
